title: Gridfinity Rugged Case
summary: Sealed, latching case whose floor is a Gridfinity baseplate, with a plexiglass window in the lid. Prints as base, lid, two latches and a TPU seal.
facts: STL print set, window SVG, build sheet

title: Gridfinity Standard Box
summary: Plain Gridfinity box to the official dimensions: stacking lip, magnet holes and 7 mm height units. Shows which Rugged Case it fits.

title: Gridfinity Box with Label
summary: Gridfinity box with a label ledge on the back wall, a separate label plate for UV printing, and a scoop at the front.
facts: Box and label plate as STL, build sheet

title: Gridfinity Baseplate
summary: Gridfinity baseplate to the official profile, sized in cells, with an optional solid bottom plate and magnet holes. Large plates are split into printable pieces.

title: Gridfinity Drawer Baseplate
summary: Enter the inside of a drawer: fits as many Gridfinity cells as possible and fills the rest with a flat border on the sides you choose, so the plate sits without play.
facts: Split into pieces of at most 360 mm
